_comment: Stop hook: prints a timestamped message to the terminal when Claude ends a session. Adapt the command to send a desktop notification (notify-send on Linux, osascript on macOS) or a Slack message via curl.

Stop._comment: Stop hooks do not have a matcher — they fire once when the session ends regardless of which tools were used.

hooks._comment: The date command uses ISO 8601 UTC format. Replace this command with your preferred notification mechanism.
